@copilot Update this existing draft PR directly on `open-telemetry/opentelemetry-java-instrumentation:copilot/migrate-jodd-http-test`. Keep the GitHub-assigned branch and any platform-assigned follow-up branch; do not rename, create a replacement branch or open a separate PR as a workaround.

Simplify `unitTests()` in `conventions/src/main/kotlin/io/opentelemetry/instrumentation/gradle/TestSuiteExecutions.kt`: it already eagerly realizes the suite, so use `create(...)` and return `JvmTestSuite` directly without changing module call sites, and update the convention tests for the direct return. Have `executions` reuse `includeInCheck()` for the default suite so there is one way to wire a suite into `check`. Preserve lazy test tasks and ensure unrelated opt-in suites are not added to `check`.

Keep suite ownership tracking for variants and use it in one real migration. I checked for duplicated unit suites and Reactor Kafka has a concrete case in `instrumentation/reactor/reactor-kafka-1.0/javaagent/build.gradle.kts`: `unitTests` and `receiveTelemetryDisabledUnitTests` compile the same test sources with the same dependencies to test receive telemetry on and off. Use the `unitTests` helper there and replace the duplicate suite with a `ReceiveTelemetryDisabled` execution variant of `unitTests`, sharing compiled tests and runtime dependencies. Keep the existing default `unitTests` execution opted into `otel.instrumentation.common.messaging.experimental.receive-telemetry.enabled=true` using `configureDefault`, and leave the disabled variant at the existing unset/disabled default. Both modes must remain in `check` and run without the agent. Preserve the existing case-insensitive owning-suite convention and standalone/installed-agent behavior; the task name alone must not make an integration variant agent-free. Keep Jodd HTTP's migration, pinned helper test version, and installed-agent coverage unchanged. Limit the migration to Reactor Kafka.

Run the focused `TestSuiteExecutionsTest`, both Reactor Kafka unit-test executions, and Jodd HTTP's helper suite in the cloud. Verify task wiring in `check`, including `-PtestLatestDeps=true` where feasible. Report what actually ran and any blockers.

replies.body: Updated in `7c75e3ed`. `unitTests()` now eagerly creates and returns `JvmTestSuite`, and default executions share `includeInCheck()`. Reactor Kafka’s disabled-receive run is now a tracked `ReceiveTelemetryDisabled` variant with default-only telemetry enabled. The focused convention test, both Reactor Kafka executions, and Jodd helper suite passed; baseline and `-PtestLatestDeps=true` dry-run check graphs include the expected suites.

@copilot Update this draft PR directly on `open-telemetry/opentelemetry-java-instrumentation:copilot/migrate-jodd-http-test`. Keep the GitHub-assigned branch and any platform-assigned follow-up branch. Do not rename a branch, create a replacement branch, or open a separate PR as a workaround. Leave the PR in draft.

Keep `unitTests()` and its targeted `check` dependency, and keep the Jodd HTTP migration with its helper tests pinned to Jodd HTTP 4.2.0. In Reactor Kafka's `javaagent/build.gradle.kts`, remove the entire `executions("unitTests")` block. Run the existing `ReactorKafkaOwnershipTest` source set once via `unitTests()`, without the agent or a receive-telemetry JVM flag. Those tests seed their own consumer contexts and use the process instrumenter. `KafkaInstrumenterFactory` uses the flag only when building the receive instrumenter. Preserve the existing installed-agent `test` and `testReceiveSpansDisabled` coverage, other integration variants, dependency graphs, and `check` wiring.

Remove the new `executionSuites` registry and variant-specific plumbing from this PR. Keep the early return in `io.opentelemetry.instrumentation.javaagent-testing.gradle.kts` before resolving or wiring the agent for normal `JvmTestSuite` tasks whose owning suite name ends in `unitTests`, case-insensitively. A standalone task or installed-agent variant with a matching suffix must still use the agent. Preserve the helper's suite-local dependency behavior and lazy test tasks. Keep focused convention tests for the behavior retained here, and update the contributor docs and Gradle instructions so they do not promise agent-free execution variants yet. Do not migrate Couchbase or make unrelated changes in this PR.

Run the focused `TestSuiteExecutionsTest` and the Jodd HTTP and Reactor Kafka `unitTests` tasks. Inspect the `check` graph in baseline and latest-dependency modes to confirm the expected tasks remain selected. Report what actually ran and any blockers.

replies.body: Implemented in `7f71c85a`. Removed Reactor Kafka’s extra unit-test execution and the suite-ownership registry. Only normal `JvmTestSuite` tasks whose suite name ends in `unitTests` are now agent-free; standalone tasks and execution variants retain agent setup. Updated the contributor guidance. The focused convention, Jodd, and Reactor Kafka unit tests passed, and baseline/latest `check` graphs retain the expected suites.

@copilot Update draft PR #21393 directly on `open-telemetry/opentelemetry-java-instrumentation:copilot/migrate-jodd-http-test`. Keep the GitHub-assigned branch and any platform-assigned follow-up branch. Do not rename or replace the branch or open a separate PR. Leave this PR in draft.

In `conventions/src/main/kotlin/io.opentelemetry.instrumentation.javaagent-testing.gradle.kts`, keep the original suite lookup and put its guard at the start of the `Test` configuration, before looking up `shadowJar`, resolving `agentForTesting`, or adding either agent dependency. Skip the agent only for a matching `JvmTestSuite` whose name ends with `unitTests`, case-insensitively. Standalone tasks, variant tasks, and installed-agent suites should behave as they do now. Remove the `isUnitTestSuite` import and both classifier methods in `conventions/src/main/kotlin/io/opentelemetry/instrumentation/gradle/TestSuiteExecutions.kt`.

Delete the `agent-free classification applies only to unit test suite tasks` test in `conventions/src/test/kotlin/io/opentelemetry/instrumentation/gradle/TestSuiteExecutionsTest.kt`. Its stand-in callback does not exercise agent jar resolution in the convention. Keep `unitTests()` and the tests for selective `check` wiring, task laziness, and dependency isolation. Leave both migrations unchanged. Keep Jodd HTTP pinned to 4.2.0 for the helper tests and retain Reactor Kafka's single ownership suite, installed-agent receive-telemetry coverage, version suites, and `dependsOn(testing.suites)`.

Run the focused `TestSuiteExecutionsTest` and the Jodd HTTP and Reactor Kafka `unitTests` tasks where feasible. Report what actually ran and any blockers.

replies.body: Implemented in `5590f944`. The agent-free guard now performs the original `JvmTestSuite` lookup before agent resolution; the classifier methods and stand-in test are removed. Focused convention, Jodd HTTP, and Reactor Kafka unit tests and the Kotlin Gradle formatting check passed.
